en: Tactile Counting: Added a satisfying animated bounce when tapping the screen to count your Azkar and Masbaha.
Menu Sizing: Dropdown menus for categories and targets now neatly hug their text without excess spacing.
Helpful Hints: The 'Tap anywhere to count' instruction is now consistently displayed under all standalone counters.
